hero.title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
hero.description: I'm a Cloud & DevOps Engineer at <company>Senior Sistemas</company>, responsible for the AWS infrastructure behind the Senior ATS by JobConvo. My day-to-day involves cloud cost optimization, CI/CD pipelines, architecture and decision-making, security, observability and production incident response, always aiming for more stable, efficient and scalable environments. Here you can find some of my projects, articles, my resume and a bit more about me.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A well-designed cloud scales, reduces costs, and improves reliability. Good architecture practices and automation make the difference.
projects.descriptionTerraform: Implementation of a complete and automated infrastructure on AWS using Terraform for provisioning, which includes VPC, ALB, EC2, Auto Scaling, database, and security configurations. The Terraform state is stored in S3 and DynamoDB, allowing versioning, encryption, concurrency locking, and high availability of the backend. The project ensures a scalable, secure, and easily reproducible environment, integrating infrastructure as code (IaC) and automation for greater efficiency.
projects.descriptionLambda: Serverless application for real-time analysis using AWS CloudTrail, Lambda, S3, and EventBridge. Automatically aggregates and processes CloudTrail logs to generate comprehensive insights into AWS account activities, security events, and resource utilization patterns through real-time data processing and multi-format reporting.
projects.descriptionCodeFlow: Complete CI/CD implementation using GitHub Actions to automate the deployment of this portfolio website to AWS S3 and CloudFront. The pipeline handles dependency management, build optimization, secure credential management, and cache invalidation. Features atomic deployments, enterprise security with IAM policies, and zero-downtime global content delivery.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a Cloud & DevOps Engineer with a background in infrastructure support and software engineering. At Senior Sistemas, I lead the AWS infrastructure of the Senior ATS by JobConvo, across production and staging. My day-to-day involves containers with Docker and ECS, databases on RDS and Aurora, queues with SQS, caching with Redis, CI/CD pipelines on GitHub, IAM and security, monitoring with CloudWatch and automation in Python. I also drive cost optimization and architecture evolution initiatives together with the development teams.
about.description2: I am always willing to learn and believe that, regardless of the technology, it is possible to master any tool or concept with dedication and practice. For me, adaptability and continuous learning are essential in the technology field.
about.description3: Beyond technology, I'm fascinated by traveling and exploring off-the-beaten-path places, I love cats and I love reading. By the way, The Name of the Wind is my favorite book.
